units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Orlah 1:3:13">Y. Orl. I, 61ᵇ</cite> top <he>אין ת׳ ביותר וכ׳</he> spices have no seasoning effect in a mixture larger than two hundred times their quantity.

<cite ref="Mishnah Arakhin 2:6">Arakh. II, 6</cite> <he>כדי ליתן ת׳ בנעימה</he> in order to put spice (sweetness) in the melody (to raise the effect of the melody through the accompaniment of young voices).

Yalk. Prov. 943 (ref. to תֵּבֵל, Prov. VIII, 31) Palestine is called tebel על שם ת׳ שבתוכה וכ׳ for the spice which is in it, and what is this? The Law; Sifré Deut. 37 תבלין, v. infra.—Pl. תְּבָלִין, (tradit. pronunc.) תַּבְלִין.
<cite ref="Mishnah Orlah 2:10">Orl. II, 10</cite> <he>ת׳ שנים וכ׳</he> spices of two or three different legal categories, of one kind or of three.
<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 2:7">Kel. II, 7</cite>, a. e. <he>בית ת׳</he> spice box.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Pesachim 10:3:3">Y. Pes. X, 37ᵈ</cite> top <he>תַּבְלֵי מצוה</he>; Bab.
<cite ref="Pesachim 116a:13">Pes. 116ᵃ</cite> <he>תֹבלין למצוה</he> spices for the Passover ceremony (<cite ref="H01630"><he>חֲרוֹסֶת</he></cite>); a. fr.—Also used as sing.
<cite ref="Shabbat 119a:7">Sabb. 119ᵃ</cite> <he>ת׳ אחד יש לנו וכ׳</he> we have a certain spice the name of which is Sabbath &c.

<cite ref="Bava Batra 16a:19">B. Bath. 16ᵃ</cite> <he>הקב״ה … תורה ת׳</he> the Lord created the evil inclination (in man), and he created the Law with which to season (temper) it; <cite ref="Kiddushin 30b:8">Kidd. 30ᵇ</cite>.
<cite ref="Sifrei Devarim 37:17">Sifré Deut. 37</cite>, v. supra; a. e.—

<cite ref="Nedarim 51a:4">Ned. 51ᵃ</cite> (play on <he>תבל</he>, <cite ref="Leviticus 18:23">Lev. XVIII, 23</cite>) <he>ת׳ הוא ת׳ יש בה וכ׳</he> is it a spice? is there any spice (additional gratification) in it? &c.—[

senses.gloss: (b. h.) confusion, unnatural act, defilement, v. supra, a. תָּבַל.]—[Y. Shebu. III, 34ᶜ top מן התבל, read: הטֶבֶל.]
